findings.location: §11 Acceptance Criteria — Reliability / Link durability gate
findings.message: The 'Link durability' gate sets thresholds RPO = 0; RTO <= 30 min but its Validation cell is only 'Recovery drill'. It names a harness but, unlike its sibling Quality/Security gates, does not state the injection condition or the pass assertion against those thresholds (zero confirmed-mapping loss; resolvability restored within 30 min). A reviewer at validation time cannot tell what the drill must demonstrate to pass. Iteration-1 findings TL-001 (C1 Security 'Pass'/'verified'), TL-002 (C2 unbound p95), and TL-003 (C4 input-domain bounds) are all resolved in the current document.
findings.recommendation: Expand the Validation cell to specify the drill scope and pass assertion, e.g. 'Recovery drill: induce mapping-store loss, confirm zero confirmed-issued mappings lost (RPO = 0) and redirect resolvability restored within 30 min (RTO <= 30 min)', matching the specificity of the adjacent fault-injection and dependency-outage gates.
